— green LP pill when macOS Energy Mode is on.

compare.title: Stable vs Beta — which should I download?
compare.subtitle: New here? Start with the green Recommended Download (App ZIP). Pick Stable for everyday use; Beta if you want every AI provider and experimental features.

rows.beta: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, Hermes

releases.title: v8.2.8-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
AES-256-GCM encryption — cloud API keys and per-provider AI chat history are encrypted at rest using CryptoKit AES-256-GCM. A device-bound 256-bit master key lives in Keychain (app.rnitro.crypto); key blobs use the RNENC1 envelope format. Existing plaintext keys and history migrate automatically on first read after upgrade.

Beta notice: Experimental features — report issues via Support.

releases.title: v8.2.7-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
Patched major bugs — fixed broken download buttons on getrnitro.netlify.app (JavaScript parse error in the support-chat knowledge base broke all page scripts), unreliable ZIP/PKG/DMG downloads (now use proper file-save links instead of full-page navigation), and Terms modal confirm edge cases. Version bump + refreshed signed App ZIP downloads.

Beta notice: Experimental features — report issues via Support.

releases.title: v8.2.6-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Patched major bugs — same website download fixes as v8.2.7 Beta. Stable channel: CPU monitor, benchmark, stress test, AI chat (OpenAI + OpenRouter), and System Advisor.

releases.title: v4.2.2-Windows-Final-x86
releases.body_html: Patched major bugs — version bump aligned with macOS v8.2.6/v8.2.7 website fixes. Windows tray monitor unchanged; download buttons on the site work again.

releases.title: v8.2.6-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
First-launch tips sheet — welcome dialog on first open with menubar icon, Gatekeeper, and App ZIP install steps.

Low Power Mode badge — green LP pill in the popover when macOS Low Power / Energy Mode is on.

Varela Round UI font across the app (bundled in the .app). Optional critical temperature banners — macOS notifications when live CPU temp or thermal pressure crosses warn/critical limits you configure in System Advisor. Includes System Advisor, iStats-style popover, all AI providers, and signed App ZIP downloads on the website.

Beta notice: Experimental features — report issues via Support.

releases.title: v8.2.5-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Stable release — CPU monitor, benchmark, stress test, and AI chat limited to OpenAI (GPT) and OpenRouter. System Advisor tab with client-side specs assistant and customizable temp/CPU/RAM/GPU/battery warnings. iStats-style sectioned menubar popover with Modern/Legacy UI toggle.

releases.title: v8.2.4-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
System Advisor tab — client-side specs assistant that reads live hardware stats and warns when temps, CPU, RAM, GPU, or battery cross thresholds you set. No API key; fully on-device. All beta AI providers included.

Beta notice: Experimental features — report issues via Support.

releases.title: v8.2.3-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html: Refinements on the v8.2.2 popover and provider stack — stability and layout polish ahead of System Advisor.

releases.title: v8.2.2-Final-arm64 / v8.2.2-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html: iStats-style sectioned popover — cleaner menubar layout with single-line stat values (no stacked CPU/RAM labels). Modern/Legacy UI toggle in Extras/Tools for users who prefer the older compact layout.

releases.title: v8.2.1-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
Full AI provider lineup — Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, and Hermes. Menu bar light/dark icons, network monitor in popover, and uninstall-rNitro.sh companion script.

Beta notice: Experimental features — report issues via Support.

releases.title: v8.1.1-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
Fully responsive UI — window and menubar popover reflow from narrow to wide; adaptive stat grids, flexible detail popups, and scrollable AI provider tabs. 14px default typography (12px in compact layouts). Fixed battery charging status; battery time remaining beside charge level; toggles to show/hide Stress Test and Benchmark.

AI Chat in menubar popover (Monitor + Chat tabs); per-provider saved history; connection status indicators (Connected / Needs API Key / Offline / Not Configured). Auth fixes for OpenRouter and LM Studio. Boba Tea Tycoon removed from UI.

Beta notice: This is a beta version — crashes and code errors are possible. Please report to Support if anything goes wrong.

releases.title: v7.0.1a-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Fully responsive CPU monitor UI — adaptive layouts, flexible stat cards, scalable charts and panels, 14px default font (12px compact). Fixed battery charging status; battery time remaining beside charge level; toggles to show/hide Stress Test and Benchmark. All monitor features with improved resize behavior. No AI chat. Boba Tea Tycoon removed.

releases.title: v8.1-Beta-arm64
releases.body_html:
Beta AI chat — Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LM Studio, Ollama, and Hermes. Cloud keys in Keychain; local LM Studio/Ollama/Hermes need no API key. All v6.2.4 monitor features included.

Beta notice: This is a beta version — crashes and code errors are possible. Please report to Support if anything goes wrong.

releases.title: v6.2.4-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Stable release — CPU monitor, Boba Tea, benchmark, fixed menu bar popover layout and in-popover stat detail popups. No AI chat.

releases.title: v6.2.3-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Gemini Chat tab in the main window — bring your own API key (stored in Mac Keychain), chat via gemini-2.0-flash. Menu bar popover unchanged (Monitor + Boba Tea only).

releases.title: v6.2.2-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Fixed temperature stuck at 50°C — wider load-based estimate, SMC peak reading (not average), and blend when package sensors read low. Minecraft server section on the website.

releases.title: v6.2.1-Final-arm64
releases.body_html: Final Apple Silicon build — live battery % and charge speed (pmset/ioreg), Boba Tea Tycoon tab, CPU/SSD fixes, stat detail sheets, game bundling, Lazy Dog UI, RAM/SSD stats, and DMG distribution.

releases.title: v4.2.1-Windows-Final-x86
releases.body_html: Final Windows x86 release — macOS-style tray monitor (BASE/BOOST/TEMP/CORES, battery, CPU graph, RAM/SSD bars, per-core list, stress test, benchmark). Pre-built .exe + PowerShell source installer. Requires .NET 8 Desktop Runtime for the EXE, or built-in .NET Framework for the .ps1 compile path.

releases.title: v6.0.1a
releases.body_html: v6 release — minimal UI redesign, Lazy Dog font, live RAM and SSD stats, improved benchmarking, clickable detail popups, and rNitro-v6.0.1a.dmg on the website.

releases.title: v5.0.0a
releases.body_html: More accurate benchmarking — 3-second timed phases, dedicated serial single-core queue, warm-up/cool-down between phases, @inline(never) hot loop, and WorkSink accumulator. Clickable BASE/BOOST/TEMP/CORES detail popups. EB Garamond font (later changed to Lazy Dog in v6).

releases.title: v5.1.2a
releases.body_html: Fixed inaccurate benchmark results. The single-core timing could be optimized away entirely since its result was never used, and multi-core rendered slightly different content than single-core, so the two scores weren't truly comparable. Both phases now render identical work, run for a fixed 2-second window each (so they self-scale to any CPU speed), include a short warm-up so clocks are ramped before timing starts, and score real completed work that the compiler can't discard.

releases.title: v5.1.1a
releases.body_html: More accurate temperatures — rNitro now reads real sensor data straight from the SMC (the same controller iStat Menus, TG Pro, and Macs Fan Control read from), falling back to the old estimate only if the SMC can't be reached. Also bumped the live refresh rate from 900ms to 750ms, so the menu bar, popover stats, and history graph all feel snappier.

releases.title: v5.0.1a
releases.body_html: Added stress test and benchmarking. A new built-in benchmark sits next to the stress test in the popover: it times a fixed, repeatable render workload — first on a single thread, then across every logical core — and turns the throughput into single-core and multi-core scores, Cinebench-style, so you get a comparable number instead of just a live load graph.

releases.title: v4.2.0
releases.body_html: Added a built-in CPU stress test. Spins up one real busy-loop thread per logical core (like Prime95 or stress-ng) so you can watch usage, temperature, and clock speed respond live under genuine full load, right inside the popover. Always user-initiated, stoppable with one click, and automatically stops if the app quits.

releases.title: v4.1.2
releases.body_html: Fixed the popover getting visually cut off. Dynamic header text (CPU name, core count) could force the app's content to grow past its declared frame, making the popover render wider than it should — now hard-clamped so this can't happen, and widened slightly for more breathing room.

releases.title: v4.1.1w-21a
releases.body_html: Added a support chatbot to the website — a small popup in the bottom-right corner that answers common questions about install, temperature readings, Windows support, BTC price, security, and uninstalling. Fully client-side, rule-based, no backend or API key. Falls back to the email support form for anything it doesn't recognize.

releases.title: Beta-v3.27w-23a
releases.body_html: Fixed minor bugs.

releases.title: v3.2.2a
releases.body_html: Fixed a compile error — ptrace() isn't bridged by Swift's Darwin module, so the anti-debugger check now resolves it via dlsym at runtime. Also replaced a deprecated Security-framework API (SecTrustGetCertificateAtIndex) with its modern equivalent (SecTrustCopyCertificateChain) in the pinned TLS session.

releases.title: v3.2.1b
releases.body_html: Added support for Windows 10 and 11 — a PowerShell installer (install-rNitro-windows.ps1) that compiles rNitro from C# source using csc.exe built into .NET Framework. No SDK download required. Includes a system tray icon, live CPU/RAM/temp popup, 60-second history graphs, and live BTC price — same data sources as the Mac version. Download on the Windows tab above.

releases.title: v3.1.3
releases.body_html: Refresh rate changed to 900ms. Added a ₿ symbol to the left of the menu bar CPU readout.

releases.title: v3.1.2b
releases.body_html: Stats now refresh every 500ms instead of every 1 second — the menu bar, popover, and game overlay HUD all feel noticeably snappier. The usage history graph buffer was doubled so it still spans a full 60 seconds at the new refresh rate.

releases.title: v3.1.2
releases.body_html: Menu bar now shows "CPU: X%  Temp: Y°" instead of just a usage percentage, so both numbers are visible at a glance without opening the popover.

releases.title: v3.1.1a
releases.body_html: Added an automatic update check. On every launch, rNitro checks getrnitro.netlify.app for the latest published version; if a newer one exists, you'll see an alert and your default browser will open to this page so you can grab it.

releases.title: v2.1.0
releases.body_html: Added an in-game overlay HUD — like MSI Afterburner's on-screen display — showing live CPU%, GPU%, temperature, and RAM. Toggle with ⌥⇧O. It's click-through and stays on top of fullscreen games without stealing input. Also added "Launch App with FPS HUD," which runs a Metal-based game with Apple's own native Metal HUD enabled for real, engine-reported FPS and frame time — we don't fake FPS numbers, since macOS has no public API to hook another process's renderer. GPU usage and RAM usage are now read from real OS sources (IOKit accelerator stats, host VM statistics) too, not estimated.

releases.title: v2.0.1a
releases.body_html: Fixed minor temperature bug — the gauge could appear stuck at one value (e.g. 40°C) while in the Nominal thermal state. It now interpolates within each thermal-state band based on live CPU usage, so it moves smoothly instead of sitting flat. Still grounded in the OS's real Nominal/Fair/Serious/Critical signal, not a synthetic guess.

releases.title: v2.0.1
releases.body_html: Fixed menu bar bug — the menu bar popover's content was getting clipped/cut off. Version bump also marks the 2.0 line — real thermal-state monitoring and menu bar mode (introduced in 1.2.2) are now the baseline.

releases.title: v1.2.2
releases.body_html: Replaced the synthetic temperature estimate with a value driven by macOS's real thermal state (ProcessInfo.thermalState) instead of a fake formula based on load — still shown in °C for readability, banded by the OS's actual Nominal/Fair/Serious/Critical signal rather than guessed. Added menu bar mode: a live CPU% readout always visible in the menu bar, with a click-to-open quick view, independent of the main window.

releases.title: v1.2.1
releases.body_html: Patched minor bug. Added a custom app icon, generated programmatically at install time and embedded into the app bundle.

releases.title: v1.1.0 — Security Update
releases.body_html: Hardened the installer end-to-end: refuses to run via curl | bash, builds in a randomized, permission-locked temp directory instead of a predictable path under Downloads, verifies all required tools exist before use, checks the compiled binary isn't a symlink before installing it, refuses to delete ~/Applications/rNitro.app if it's been swapped for a symlink, tightens file permissions throughout, and ad-hoc code-signs the final app bundle. The self-verifying SHA-256 checksum is now pinned and published above.

releases.title: v1.0 — Initial release
releases.body_html: First public release. Native CPU usage, temperature, clock speed, and per-core monitoring, compiled locally via swiftc.
